account.syncHint: When enabled, saves your current settings on the server for your Bungie account and restores them on your other devices. When disabled, they are saved in a cookie stored in this browser.

syncFailedHint.rejected: The server rejected this browser’s groups: they are kept here, but the version saved to the account is out of date.
syncFailedHint.offline: This browser’s groups could not be sent. They are kept here and sending will be retried.

account.restoreHint: This browser keeps a safety copy from {date} holding {groups, plural, one {1 group missing} other {# groups missing}} from the current list.
account.restoreConfirm: Add {groups, plural, one {the missing group} other {the # missing groups}} from the safety copy to the current list?
account.clearSyncHint: Delete the settings synchronization data saved on the server and turns settings synchronization off. The ones in this browser are kept.
account.clearSyncConfirm: You are about to delete the settings synchronization data saved on the server and turn it off. Do you want to continue?
account.deleteAllHint: Deletes all of the data the site keeps about this Bungie account (this includes settings synchronization data, loadout groups, etc.), and signs you out.
account.deleteAllConfirm: You are about to delete ALL of the data tied to this Bungie account saved on the server. You are also going to be signed out of your account. Do you want to continue?
account.exportHint: Downloads your settings and loadout groups as a JSON file, to keep or to load in another browser.
account.importHint: Reads back an exported file. The settings and groups it holds replace those of this browser.
account.importDone: Imported — settings: {settings, select, true {yes} other {no}}, {groups, plural, =0 {no groups} one {1 group} other {# groups}}.

importFailure.unreadable: Unreadable file: this is not JSON exported from this site.
importFailure.empty: This file holds neither settings nor loadout groups.
importFailure.badGroups: The loadout groups in this file are malformed: nothing was imported.

search.syntaxHint: Destiny Item Manager's: is:, stat:, basestat:, perkname:, power:, id:… combined with and, or, not and parentheses. A bare word searches the item and perk names.
